findings.note: MA House, On adoption of amendment #7 (H.4359) - failed, 2022-01-27: yea (tally 32–126); census gate: none.

Lead sponsor of S.510, a petition for legislation to provide a photo identification card to be used for voting purposes. Referred to the Election Laws committee on 2/27/2025; hearing scheduled 7/8/2025. The bill page gives its purpose as 'to ensure safe and secure elections'.
Listed as a petitioner (co-sponsor) of S.335, 'An Act requiring photo identification to receive a ballot' (filed 2013-01-22).
